who: Photographs weddings from May to October and spends the winter editing, invoicing and catching up.

moments.plot: Paloma and Yusuf’s gallery goes out next week. Their album is the last one of the season.

tasks.title: Second pass on the dance floor
tasks.notes: Keep the blurry one of the aunt. It is the best picture of the night.

tasks.title: Pick a cover with Paloma
tasks.notes: She liked the one on the stairs. The one in the rain is better and she knows it.

tasks.title: Fix the suits, they look blue
Ask which song for the slideshow

file.title: Album paper: matte or silk?
file.notes: Samples are in the blue drawer. Matte hides fingers.

dated.title: Send the gallery
dated.notes: Upload on {weekday+4} night so the link is warm in the morning.

repeating.title: Copy the week to the drive at home
repeating.notes: Both drives. Then put one in the other room.

attachments.notes: The one where she laughs with her eyes shut. Yusuf says no glass in the frame. A4, on the heavy paper.

tasks.title: Dawn surf if the wind drops
Collect the long lens from repair
Coffee with a couple for June
Wax, and the crack in the board

agent.title: Write the gallery email
agent.notes: Link, password, how long it stays up, and how to order prints. Last year’s was too long.
agent.question: How should it sound?
bodies: Dear Paloma and Yusuf, here they are. The gallery stays up for a year and the password is on your card. I hope you find the aunt.
Dear Paloma and Yusuf, here is your gallery. 1. Open the link and type the password from your card. 2. Tap the heart on your favourites. 3. Order prints from the same page.
agent.otherBody: Dear Paloma and Yusuf, your gallery is ready and stays up for a year. {answer}
agent.otherAnswer: Warm, with the download steps at the end
agent.acceptance: The email is ready to send with the link.

discuss.title: Answer the couple with the smaller budget
discuss.notes: They want all day. Their number covers about five hours.
discuss.question: What would you rather offer?
bodies: Thank you for telling me your budget. It covers five hours, which is the ceremony, the portraits and the first dance.
Thank you for telling me your budget. If you can marry on a weekday, I can be there all day for that price.
discuss.otherBody: Thank you for telling me your budget. Here is what I can offer: {answer}
discuss.otherAnswer: Three hours and the portraits after

review.title: Write the gallery email
review.note: Six lines. The password is not in it, as you asked.

review.title: Match the season’s invoices to payments
review.note: Twenty-two of 23 are paid. The July one is half paid.

faded: Learn to read the tide table
